{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH RECURSIVE theme_sub AS (
  SELECT id FROM themes WHERE name = 'Collectible Minifigures'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT t.id FROM themes t JOIN theme_sub ts ON t.parent_id = ts.id
),
target_sets AS (
  SELECT s.set_num FROM sets s WHERE s.year = 2024 AND s.theme_id IN (SELECT id FROM theme_sub)
),
inv AS (
  SELECT i.id, i.set_num, i.version,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.set_num ORDER BY i.version DESC) rn
  FROM inventories i
),
cur AS (
  SELECT id, set_num FROM inv WHERE rn = 1
),
-- explode each target set's current inventory recursively, counting minifig quantities
exploded AS (
  SELECT c.set_num AS root_set, im.fig_num, im.quantity
  FROM cur c
  JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = c.id
  WHERE c.set_num IN (SELECT set_num FROM target_sets)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT e.root_set, im.fig_num, e.quantity * im.quantity
  FROM exploded e
  JOIN cur c2 ON c2.set_num = e.set_num
  JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = c2.id AND iset.set_num = e.set_num
  JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = c2.id
)
SELECT SUM(quantity) AS total_minifigs FROM exploded"}

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH RECURSIVE th AS (SELECT id FROM themes WHERE name = 'Architecture' UNION SELECT t.id FROM themes t JOIN th ON t.parent_id = th.id), tgt AS (SELECT set_num FROM sets WHERE year = 2019 AND theme_id IN (SELECT id FROM th)), cur AS (SELECT set_num, id FROM (SELECT set_num, id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY set_num ORDER BY version DESC) rn FROM inventories) WHERE rn = 1), ex AS (SELECT set_num AS root, set_num AS item, CAST(1 AS BIGINT) AS mult FROM tgt UNION ALL SELECT ex.root, c.child, ex.mult * c.qty FROM ex JOIN cur ON cur.set_num = ex.item JOIN (SELECT inventory_id, set_num AS child, quantity AS qty FROM inventory_sets UNION ALL SELECT inventory_id, fig_num, quantity FROM inventory_minifigs) c ON c.inventory_id = cur.id), per AS (SELECT t.set_num, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(ex.mult * ip.quantity) FROM ex JOIN cur ON cur.set_num = ex.item JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = cur.id AND NOT ip.is_spare WHERE ex.root = t.set_num), 0) AS n FROM tgt t) SELECT ROUND(AVG(n), 2) AS avg_parts, COUNT(*) AS n_sets, SUM(CASE WHEN n = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS zero_sets FROM per"}
